newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound interbank rates fall in liquid market.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound interbank rates fall in liquid market.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound fell on Tuesday in a slightly liquid market to between 8-1/8 and 8-1/2 percent from 8-1/2 and nine percent on Monday, bankers said.
One banker said he dealt at between 7-1/2 and 8-1/2 percent.
The fall is attributable to usual end of week liquidity as well as below average yields on treasury-bills, bankers said. Thursday is a public holiday to mark Prophet Mohammad's birthday.
One-week trading rates were also lower at between eight and 8-1/2 percent compared to 8-3/4 and 9-1/4 percent, they added.
